breakpoints.note: The SAV header and the first dictionary-record pass have succeeded, the input has been rewound to the first record, and the parser enters the second pass that reaches the crafted variable record.

The project parser materializes the packed attacker-controlled SAV variable record in local variable; for the vulnerable second-pass record, its n_missing_values bytes are 00 00 00 80 and decode as INT32_MIN on this little-endian run.

The vulnerable code checks only an upper bound after applying abs(). It has no pre-abs lower-bound predicate to reject the singular INT32_MIN value, for which abs is not representable as int and remains negative on the executed build. The patch establishes the missing obligation before abs with `info->n_missing_values > 3 || info->n_missing_values < -3`.
